newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products end week mixed.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products end week mixed.

text.p: NWE oil products ended the week mixed on Friday, traders said. Gasoline gained about $1-$2 a tonne with support from crude's continued contango and tightness in the Med.
Naphtha eased with crude futures amid ample supplies.
Gas oil eased on lower futures, with low sulphur diesel coming under particular pressure as Mediterranean material came into the north.

High sulphur fuel oil barges, propped up by bunker demand, rose to trade at $83.50 and $83 after earlier trading at $80.25. Low sulphur was talked $2 weaker at $92/94, with traders saying pressure came from weaker swaps. --London newsroom, +44 171 542 8145
